productSurfaces.description: Governed view of an agent identity, actor attribution, authority and delegation, execution activity, communications, risk, evidence, and measured outcomes.

domainSlots.description: Agent identity and canonical entity context.
Canonical actor and subject attribution attached to agent activity.
Agent access, authority context, and delegation lineage.
Execution lifecycle evidence and temporal trace.
Observed actions, tools, and resource activity.
Observed agent messages joined through tenant-scoped inbox records, alongside communication events associated with agent work.
Risk, fraud, social, and relationship context with source evidence.
Economic facts and authoritative payment or commerce evidence.
Measured outcomes linked to the agent activity.
Evidence and source provenance for claims included in the frame.
Temporal state and relationship context surrounding agent activity.

productSurfaces.description: Governed view of one execution lifecycle, attributed actors and delegation, action/tool/resource activity, evidence, and outcomes.

domainSlots.description: Execution identity, lifecycle state, and execution facts.

Observed actions, tools, and resources in the execution.
Execution time context and associated episode.
Evidence and source trace for execution claims.
Exact AI execution costs and separately measured business outcomes linked to a run.

Measured outcomes linked to the episode.
